stable.notes: Miles Windu V15.4 publishes the approved 26-frame four-plus-session story: rear-facing block, underhand rising cut, slash follow-through, staged Force lift and chest thrust, and clearer blaster travel. Stock idle now uses the approved 1.30x scale to match combat character size. Exact-stock older packs upgrade automatically; custom art and non-stock pose scales stay untouched. Other session stories, characters, ledger UI, and saved global size and speed are unchanged. The complete swarm plays in 5.72 seconds at 100% speed. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
